name: OCI Generative AI
description: Provides Oracle Cloud's managed model inference, OpenAI-compatible Responses API, agent tools, vector stores and guardrails, for enterprises building governed AI apps and agents on OCI.

skills.name: Responses API
skills.description: Calls hosted or imported models through an OpenAI-compatible Responses API with conversation state, streaming and background runs.

skills.name: Agent Tools
skills.description: Adds file search, code interpreter, function calling and MCP calling to Responses API requests.

skills.name: Embeddings and Rerank

skills.name: Guardrails
skills.description: Applies content moderation, prompt-injection detection and PII detection to model inputs and outputs.

skills.name: NL2SQL
